description: SOTA Social Loop 90gg — WR2 editorial KPIs. 3 pillars (learn, lead, community) + posting heatmap + top posts. Backed by war_room_posts + m13_post_metrics via Postgres datasource.

panels.title: Pillar LEARN — engagement rate 7d rolling
panels.description: Reach-normalized engagement for posts tagged pillar=learn. Red zone below baseline − 20%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', m.captured_at) AS time,
       AVG((m.likes + m.comments + m.saves)::float / NULLIF(m.reach,0)) AS engagement_rate
FROM m13_post_metrics m
JOIN war_room_posts p ON p.post_id = m.post_id
WHERE p.pillar = 'learn'
  AND m.captured_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pillar LEAD — DM/profile-visits 7d rolling
panels.description: Lead intent proxy: DMs + profile visits normalized by reach. Below baseline − 20% triggers /publisher off alert.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', m.captured_at) AS time,
       AVG((m.dm_count + m.profile_visits)::float / NULLIF(m.reach,0)) AS lead_rate
FROM m13_post_metrics m
JOIN war_room_posts p ON p.post_id = m.post_id
WHERE p.pillar = 'lead'
  AND m.captured_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pillar COMMUNITY — replies + saves 7d rolling
panels.description: Community depth proxy: replies + saves. Soft signal for WR2 cadence tuning.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', m.captured_at) AS time,
       AVG((m.replies + m.saves)::float / NULLIF(m.reach,0)) AS community_rate
FROM m13_post_metrics m
JOIN war_room_posts p ON p.post_id = m.post_id
WHERE p.pillar = 'community'
  AND m.captured_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Posting heatmap — WITA hour × day-of-week (30d)
panels.description: Cadence validation for 06_cadence_engine.json. Highlights hot hours (optimal: 07, 12, 19 WITA per plan).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(p.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Makassar', 'FMDay') AS day_of_week,
       EXTRACT(HOUR FROM p.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Makassar') AS hour_wita,
       COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM war_room_posts p
WHERE p.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Top 10 posts last 7d (engagement absolute)
panels.description: Post leaderboard — used in M13 weekly report and Consiglio v1 monthly retrain baseline.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.post_external_id AS ig_id,
       p.channel,
       p.pillar,
       p.published_at,
       m.likes, m.comments, m.saves, m.reach,
       (m.likes + m.comments + m.saves) AS engagement_abs
FROM war_room_posts p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT likes, comments, saves, reach
  FROM m13_post_metrics
  WHERE post_id = p.post_id
  ORDER BY captured_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) m ON TRUE
WHERE p.published_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY engagement_abs DESC
LIMIT 10

title: SOTA Social — Loop 90gg Editorial KPIs
